commands.name: /set-botrole
commands.description: Assigns the role that grants staff-level Nexus management.

commands.name: /set-cmdlog
commands.description: Sets the prefix/no-prefix command audit channel.

commands.name: /config
commands.description: Displays configured server roles and channels.

commands.name: /setupbot
commands.description: Creates a private NEXUS LOGS category and four log channels, then saves their IDs.

commands.name: /kick
commands.argumentNotes: member; slash reason required (prefix reason is accepted after member)
commands.description: Kicks a member and records a moderation case.

commands.name: /ban
commands.description: Bans a member; slash option can delete recent message history; records a case.

commands.name: /softban
commands.description: Bans then immediately unbans to remove recent messages; records a case.

commands.name: /mute
commands.description: Times a member out; timeout expiration is persisted and restored by the bot.

commands.name: /warn
commands.description: Stores a warning and reports it to the user.

commands.name: /clearwarns
commands.description: Deletes stored warnings for a member. Prefix counterpart not found.

commands.name: /modlogs
commands.description: Displays moderation case history. Prefix spelling is an alias of n!warnings.

commands.name: /lockdown
commands.description: Applies a server-wide or scoped messaging lockdown.

commands.name: /role add
commands.description: Assigns a role, subject to role hierarchy.

commands.name: /role remove
commands.description: Removes a role, subject to role hierarchy.

commands.name: /purge
commands.description: Deletes recent messages in the current channel.

commands.name: /lock
commands.description: Disables @everyone message sending in a channel.

commands.name: /autorole set-human
commands.description: Sets a role to assign automatically to new human members.

commands.name: /reactionrole panel
commands.argumentNotes: title, description, up to five role slots, channel
commands.description: Creates a button panel through which members can self-assign configured roles.
commands.example: /reactionrole panel channel:#channel role:@Staff title:"Support" description:"Open a ticket"

commands.name: /rank
commands.description: Shows a member’s level, XP, and progress.

commands.name: /leveling reward
commands.description: Adds or removes a milestone role reward.

commands.name: /autoresponder add
commands.description: Adds an exact/contains/wildcard trigger response (actual supported values should be taken from the option declaration).

commands.name: /tictactoe
commands.description: Starts a turn-based 3×3 game with button interaction.

commands.name: /rps
commands.description: Plays Rock-Paper-Scissors against the bot or another member.

commands.name: /guess
commands.description: Starts a number-guessing game from 1 to 100.

commands.name: /giveaway start
commands.argumentNotes: channel; optional role; modal collects giveaway details
commands.description: Starts a giveaway with persistent entry state and optional role eligibility.

commands.name: /giveaway list
commands.description: Lists active giveaways in this server.

commands.name: /poll
commands.argumentNotes: optional channel and role; modal collects question/options
commands.description: Creates a button poll with optional role restriction.

commands.name: /endpoll
commands.description: Closes a poll and reports results.

commands.name: /ticket setup
commands.example: /ticket setup channel:#channel title:"Support" description:"Open a ticket" color:#5865F2

commands.name: /ticket close
commands.description: Closes an active ticket and produces a transcript.

commands.name: /ticket add
commands.description: Grants a member access to the current ticket.

commands.name: /ticket remove
commands.description: Removes a member’s access to the current ticket.

commands.name: /announce
commands.argumentNotes: channel; optional embed/ping/image/thumbnail options; interactive modal
commands.description: Composes and publishes a text or embed announcement.

commands.name: /dm-user
commands.description: Sends a direct message to one member and logs delivery outcome.

commands.name: /dm-role
commands.description: Sends a direct message to members with a role, with progress/rate handling.

commands.name: /ping
commands.description: Reports gateway and API response latency.

commands.name: /uptime
commands.description: Reports time since the process started.

commands.name: /serverinfo
commands.description: Displays information about the current server.

commands.name: n!addnp
commands.description: Adds a global non-prefix command allowlist entry.

commands.name: n!sync
commands.description: Synchronizes slash command definitions with Discord.

commands.name: n!invite
commands.description: Returns an invite link generated from the active bot ID.
